units.characteristics: reverent integrity; protective, anxious piety
units.gist: PROLOGUE - Job blameless and upright, one who feared God and turned from evil; rising early to intercede for his children lest they 'cursed God in their hearts' - piety that reaches into the unseen interior of others

units.characteristics: the question of disinterested piety (does Job fear God for no reason?)
units.gist: THE WAGER - the accuser's challenge: 'Does Job fear God for no reason?' - the book's engine-question about the MOTIVE of the inner life: is reverence self-interested or free?

units.characteristics: worship in catastrophic loss; integrity holding
units.gist: GEM - the four blows; Job tears his robe, falls and WORSHIPS: 'the LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD'; 'in all this Job did not sin or charge God with wrong' - grief and worship in one act

units.characteristics: integrity under bodily affliction; the tested self refusing to curse
units.gist: GEM - the second test reaches bone and flesh; the wife: 'Curse God and die'; Job: 'Shall we receive good from God, and shall we not receive evil?'; 'in all this Job did not sin with his lips' - integrity held at the body's extremity

units.characteristics: the ministry of silent presence; shared grief
units.gist: the three friends come, weep, tear their robes, and sit with him seven days and nights, 'no one spoke a word, for they saw his suffering was very great' - grief honoured by silent companionship (before the words spoil it)

units.characteristics: the self recoiling against its own existence
units.gist: Job breaks silence cursing the day of his birth - 'let the day perish on which I was born'; the interior turned against its own beginning, wishing itself un-created

units.characteristics: the longing for death as rest
units.gist: 'why did I not die at birth?' - death imagined as the place where 'the weary are at rest', the prisoners at ease, the slave free; the death-longing as a craving for REST from anguish

units.characteristics: the dread realized; the loss of all inner rest
units.gist: GEM - 'why is light given to the bitter in soul, who long for death but it comes not?'; 'the thing that I fear comes upon me'; 'I am not at ease, nor am I quiet; I have no rest, but trouble comes' - dread fulfilled, rest gone

units.characteristics: piety appealed to as confidence; the retribution principle
units.gist: Eliphaz begins gently - 'is not your fear of God your confidence, and the integrity of your ways your hope?'; then the principle: 'who that was innocent ever perished?' - suffering read as guilt's harvest

units.characteristics: the dread encounter; man's impurity before God
units.gist: GEM - Eliphaz's night vision, dread and trembling shaking his bones, a voice: 'Can mortal man be in the right before God? Can a man be pure before his Maker?' - the creaturely smallness/impurity theme (recurs 15:14, 25:4)

units.characteristics: vexation that kills; trouble as man's native soil
units.gist: 'vexation kills the fool, and jealousy slays the simple' - the passions as self-destroying; 'man is born to trouble as the sparks fly upward' - trouble as the human condition

units.characteristics: the counsel to seek God; God who lifts the lowly
units.gist: 'as for me, I would seek God, and to God would I commit my cause' - the posture Eliphaz commends; God who sets the lowly on high and frustrates the crafty

units.characteristics: suffering received as the discipline of God
units.gist: 'blessed is the one whom God reproves; despise not the discipline of the Almighty. For he wounds, but he binds up' - suffering reframed as loving correction (a true idea, mis-applied to Job; recurs in Elihu 36:8-15)

units.characteristics: the crushing weight of anguish; the death-wish; strength spent
units.gist: GEM - 'oh that my vexation were weighed... heavier than the sand of the sea'; 'the arrows of the Almighty are in me; my spirit drinks their poison'; the longing that God would crush him; 'what is my strength, that I should wait?'

units.characteristics: the betrayal of friends; kindness withheld
units.gist: 'he who withholds kindness from a friend forsakes the fear of the Almighty'; the friends 'treacherous as a torrent-bed' that runs dry in the heat - the failure of those who should comfort (thread: the false comforters)

units.characteristics: the plea for honest reproof; the despairing man's words as wind
units.gist: 'teach me, and I will be silent; make me understand how I have gone astray'; 'the speech of a despairing man is wind' - the openness to correction if only it were just, and the plea to be believed

units.characteristics: life as hard service; the sleepless, hopeless self
units.gist: 'has not man a hard service on earth?'; 'months of emptiness, nights of misery'; 'when I lie down... the night is long, and I toss and turn'; 'my days... come to their end without hope' - weariness and sleepless dread

units.characteristics: the audacious turn to God; the complaint that will not be restrained
units.gist: GEM - 'I will not restrain my mouth; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul'; the bold inversion of Ps 8 - 'what is man, that you make so much of him... visit him every morning and test him?'; 'why have you made me your mark?' - complaint addressed straight to God

units.characteristics: the appeal to God's unbending justice; repent and be restored
units.gist: Bildad - 'does God pervert justice?'; if your children sinned, they got their due; 'if you are pure and upright... he will rouse himself for you' - the retribution creed applied bluntly

units.characteristics: the wisdom of the ancestors; the perishing hope of the godless
units.gist: 'inquire of bygone ages'; 'the paths of all who forget God... the hope of the godless shall perish', his confidence 'a spider's web'; yet 'God will yet fill your mouth with laughter'

units.characteristics: the unanswerable God; man cannot be in the right before him
units.gist: 'how can a man be in the right before God? If one wished to contend with him, one could not answer once in a thousand times'; the cosmic power that 'passes by me, and I see him not' - the sense of a God too great to argue with

units.characteristics: the crisis of justice; 'he destroys both the blameless and the wicked'
units.gist: GEM - 'though I am in the right, I cannot answer him'; 'it is all one; therefore I say, He destroys both the blameless and the wicked' - the collapse of the moral order Job had trusted; the innocent and guilty leveled

units.characteristics: the longing for an arbiter between man and God
units.gist: GEM - 'if I wash myself with snow... yet you will plunge me into a pit'; 'there is no arbiter between us, who might lay his hand on us both' - the first cry for a MEDIATOR (thread: arbiter 9:33 -> witness 16:19 -> Redeemer 19:25)

units.characteristics: the loathing of life; the demand to know the charge
units.gist: 'I loathe my life; I will give free utterance to my complaint'; 'let me know why you contend against me'; 'do you have eyes of flesh?' - the plea to understand the reason for the suffering

units.characteristics: the Maker who now destroys; hidden purpose
units.gist: GEM - 'your hands fashioned and made me... and now you have destroyed me'; 'you granted me life and steadfast love, and your care preserved my spirit. Yet these things you hid in your heart' - the wound of the Maker turned against his own work

units.characteristics: the plea for a little cheer before the dark
units.gist: 'why did you bring me out from the womb?'; 'let me alone, that I may find a little cheer before I go... to the land of darkness and deep shadow' - the small mercy asked at the edge of death

units.characteristics: the rebuke of Job's self-defense; the unsearchable God
units.gist: Zophar - 'should your babble silence men?'; 'can you find out the deep things of God? higher than heaven, deeper than Sheol' - God's unsearchableness wielded to silence Job's protest

units.characteristics: the promise of security to the repentant heart
units.gist: 'if you prepare your heart... put iniquity far away, then you will lift up your face without blemish; you will be secure and will not fear; you will forget your misery' - repentance-for-restoration offered

units.characteristics: the laughingstock; the contempt of the comfortable for the fallen
units.gist: 'I am a laughingstock to my friends, I who called to God and he answered me'; 'in the thought of one who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune' - the ease that despises the suffering

units.characteristics: the sovereignty that unmakes; wisdom that dismantles the mighty
units.gist: 'ask the beasts and they will teach you'; God 'leads counselors away stripped, makes judges fools... deprives of speech those who are trusted, takes away discernment of the elders' - the God who unmakes human wisdom and power

units.characteristics: the demand to argue with God; the friends' false comfort exposed
units.gist: GEM - 'I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to argue my case with God'; 'you whitewash with lies; worthless physicians are you all'; 'will you speak falsely FOR God?' - honest complaint preferred over pious lying

units.characteristics: faith-defiance: 'though he slay me, I will hope in him'
units.gist: GEM - 'let come on me what may... though he slay me, I will hope in him; yet I will argue my ways to his face'; 'I know that I shall be in the right' - trust and protest fused; hope that will still contend

units.characteristics: the plea against terror; 'why do you hide your face?'
units.gist: 'withdraw your hand far from me, and let not dread of you terrify me'; 'why do you hide your face and count me as your enemy?' - the longing to meet God without being crushed by dread (thread: the hidden face)

units.characteristics: the frailty of man; few days and full of trouble
units.gist: 'man who is born of a woman is few of days and full of trouble; he comes out like a flower and withers... flees like a shadow'; 'who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean?' - human transience and impurity

units.characteristics: the longing for life beyond death; hidden till the wrath is past
units.gist: GEM - 'there is hope for a tree, if cut down, that it will sprout again... but a man dies and is laid low'; 'if a man dies, shall he live again? All the days of my service I would wait, till my renewal should come' - the resurrection-longing reaching toward hope

units.characteristics: the destroyed hope of man; mourning only for himself
units.gist: 'so you destroy the hope of man'; 'he feels only the pain of his own body, and he mourns only for himself' - hope worn away like stone by water; the isolated suffering self

units.characteristics: the charge of impiety; man drinking injustice like water
units.gist: Eliphaz hardens - 'you are doing away with the fear of God and hindering meditation before God'; 'what is man, that he can be pure?... a man who drinks injustice like water' - the corruption theme turned accusing

units.characteristics: the inner torment of the wicked; the guilty conscience
units.gist: GEM - 'the wicked man writhes in pain all his days'; 'dreadful sounds are in his ears'; 'distress and anguish terrify him' - the wicked's own conscience as his torturer (the interior as its own hell)

units.characteristics: miserable comforters; the failure of comfort
units.gist: 'miserable comforters are you all'; 'I also could speak as you do, if you were in my place... but I would strengthen you with my mouth' - Job naming what true comfort would be, against what he received

units.characteristics: God experienced as assailant; the body broken
units.gist: 'God has worn me out... he has torn me in his wrath and hated me; he has gnashed his teeth at me'; 'my face is red with weeping' - suffering felt as God's personal assault, though 'my prayer is pure'

units.characteristics: the witness in heaven; the advocate longing
units.gist: GEM - 'even now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and he who testifies for me is on high'; 'that he would argue the case of a man with God' - the mediator-longing deepens (arbiter -> WITNESS -> Redeemer)

units.characteristics: the broken spirit; the righteous holding to his way
units.gist: 'my spirit is broken; my days are extinct'; mockers around him; yet 'the righteous holds to his way, and he who has clean hands grows stronger and stronger' - integrity clung to amid collapse

units.characteristics: hope collapsing into Sheol
units.gist: 'my days are past; my plans are broken off, the desires of my heart'; 'if I say to the pit, You are my father... where then is my hope?' - hope reaching only toward the grave

units.characteristics: the self-tearing anger (as the friend sees it)
units.gist: Bildad - 'you who tear yourself in your anger, shall the earth be forsaken for you?' - Job's anguish read (unsympathetically) as self-destruction

units.characteristics: the terror and oblivion of the wicked
units.gist: 'the light of the wicked is put out'; 'terrors frighten him on every side'; 'his memory perishes from the earth, and he has no name in the street' - the wicked hunted by terror and erased (the terror + oblivion of guilt)

units.characteristics: tormented by words; God felt as the wronger
units.gist: 'how long will you torment me and break me in pieces with words?'; 'know then that God has put me in the wrong'; 'I cry Violence! but I am not answered' - assailed by friends and by an apparently hostile God

units.characteristics: utter estrangement; abandoned by all
units.gist: GEM - brothers, relatives, close friends, servants, wife, even young children all turned away: 'those whom I loved have turned against me'; 'have mercy on me, O you my friends' - total human isolation

units.characteristics: the Redeemer lives; 'in my flesh I shall see God'
units.gist: GEM - the summit of Job's faith: 'I know that my Redeemer lives, and at the last he will stand upon the earth... yet in my flesh I shall see God, whom I shall see for myself'; 'my heart faints within me' - hope's highest reach out of the depths (arbiter -> witness -> REDEEMER)

units.characteristics: the brevity of the wicked's joy
units.gist: Zophar - 'the exulting of the wicked is short, and the joy of the godless but for a moment'; he will 'fly away like a dream' - the transience of ill-gotten gladness

units.characteristics: sin sweet in the mouth turning to poison; the insatiable wicked
units.gist: 'though evil is sweet in his mouth, though he hides it under his tongue... yet his food is turned in his stomach; it is the venom of cobras within him'; 'because he knew no contentment in his belly' - sin's sweetness recoiling; the never-content wicked

units.characteristics: the prosperity of the wicked (the crisis of retribution)
units.gist: GEM - 'why do the wicked live, reach old age, and grow mighty in power?'; their houses safe, their children dancing; 'they say to God, Depart from us' yet prosper - the direct challenge to the friends' whole system

units.characteristics: the uneven fates; death levels all
units.gist: 'one dies in his full vigor, wholly at ease; another dies in bitterness of soul, never having tasted prosperity. They lie down alike in the dust' - fate does not track righteousness; 'how then will you comfort me with empty nothings?'

units.characteristics: the invention of Job's sins (accusation without evidence)
units.gist: Eliphaz's final escalation - 'is not your evil abundant?'; imagining crimes: stripped the naked, sent widows away empty - the comforter turned false accuser (the interior projected as guilt)

units.characteristics: the charge of practical atheism
units.gist: 'you say, What does God know? Can he judge through the deep darkness?' - Eliphaz attributing to Job the wicked's assumption that God does not see

units.characteristics: the call to return; delight in the Almighty
units.gist: GEM (true words, wrong target) - 'agree with God, and be at peace'; 'receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart'; 'then you will delight yourself in the Almighty and lift up your face to God' - genuine invitation to intimacy

units.characteristics: the longing to find God's seat and plead the case
units.gist: GEM - 'oh, that I knew where I might find him, that I might come even to his seat! I would lay my case before him and fill my mouth with arguments' - the craving for ACCESS to God's court, sure of acquittal there

units.characteristics: the tested-gold faith held with terror; God hidden yet trusted
units.gist: GEM - 'I go forward, but he is not there... but he knows the way that I take; when he has tried me, I shall come out as gold'; 'my foot has held fast to his steps'; yet 'God has made my heart faint... I am in dread of him' - trust and terror together

units.characteristics: the unpunished oppression of the poor; God's seeming absence from justice
units.gist: 'why are not times of judgment kept by the Almighty?'; the poor stripped, hungry, naked; 'the soul of the wounded cries for help; yet God charges no one with wrong' - the scandal of unanswered injustice

units.characteristics: the workers of darkness; judgment delayed
units.gist: 'those who rebel against the light' - the murderer, adulterer, thief who love the dark; 'they are exalted a little while, and then are gone' - evil unpunished for now, but not forever

units.characteristics: human worthlessness before God (the friends' last word)
units.gist: Bildad's brief final speech - 'how can man be in the right before God?... man, who is a maggot, and the son of man, who is a worm' - the creaturely-impurity theme reduced to contempt (the debate exhausted)

units.characteristics: the sarcasm at hollow help
units.gist: 'how you have helped him who has no power! How you have counseled him who has no wisdom!' - Job's bitter irony at the friends' useless counsel

units.characteristics: the majesty of God; only the outskirts of his ways
units.gist: 'he hangs the earth on nothing'; 'Sheol is naked before God'; 'these are but the outskirts of his ways, and how small a whisper do we hear of him!' - awe at the God whose full power is beyond hearing

units.characteristics: the oath of integrity; the heart that does not reproach
units.gist: GEM - 'till I die I will not put away my integrity from me. I hold fast my righteousness and will not let it go; my heart does not reproach me for any of my days' - integrity sworn against all pressure to confess false guilt

units.characteristics: the portion of the wicked affirmed
units.gist: 'this is the portion of a wicked man with God' - Job affirms that in the end the wicked's gains are stripped ('the righteous will wear it'); 'terrors overtake him like a flood' - Job's own version of retribution, longer-viewed

units.characteristics: the reach of human searching (the miner)
units.gist: the WISDOM POEM - man's astonishing search: mining silver and gold, putting 'an end to darkness', searching 'to the farthest limit', bringing 'the thing that is hidden out to light' - the searching self penetrating everywhere

units.characteristics: but wisdom cannot be found or bought
units.gist: 'but where shall wisdom be found?... it is not found in the land of the living'; 'it cannot be bought for gold' - the one thing the all-searching self cannot dig out or purchase (the limit of the seeking mind)

units.characteristics: the fear of the LORD is wisdom
units.gist: GEM - only 'God understands the way to it'; and to man he said: 'Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding' - the fear-of-God climax (echoes 1:1; shared w/ Pro 1:7, Ps 111:10, Ecc 12:13)

units.characteristics: the lost intimacy with God; the friendship of God
units.gist: GEM - 'oh, that I were as in the months of old, when God watched over me... when the friendship of God was upon my tent' - the ache for a lost nearness to God (the sweetest thing Job mourns is not wealth but the FRIENDSHIP)

units.characteristics: the remembered life of active compassion; honour founded on mercy
units.gist: 'I delivered the poor who cried for help... I was eyes to the blind and feet to the lame, a father to the needy'; 'I broke the fangs of the unrighteous' - the interior life expressed as justice and mercy; honour rooted in doing good

units.characteristics: the reversal; mocked by the lowest
units.gist: 'but now they laugh at me, men younger than I'; the outcasts now deride him: 'I have become their song; I am a byword to them'; 'they do not hesitate to spit at the sight of me' - honour turned to contempt

units.characteristics: the poured-out soul; the churning interior; the unanswered cry
units.gist: GEM - 'my soul is poured out within me'; 'I cry to you for help and you do not answer me'; 'my inward parts are in turmoil and never still'; 'when I hoped for good, evil came' - the interior in ceaseless turmoil before a silent God

units.characteristics: the covenant with the eyes; guarded desire
units.gist: 'I have made a covenant with my eyes; how then could I gaze at a virgin?' - integrity begun at the level of the LOOK, the desire governed at its source (cf. Ecc 6:9, the eyes)

units.characteristics: justice to the powerless; the shared-Maker conscience
units.gist: the oath of innocence toward servant, poor, widow, fatherless; 'did not he who made me in the womb make him?' - the interior ethic grounded in a common creation; compassion as covenant

units.characteristics: the hidden-heart integrity; no secret idolatry or gloating
units.gist: GEM - not trusting gold; not rejoicing at an enemy's ruin; not 'concealing my transgressions... by hiding my iniquity in my heart' - integrity tested at the INVISIBLE layer (the heart's secret loves and hatreds)

units.characteristics: the final challenge; the signature
units.gist: 'oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me'; 'like a prince I would approach him'; 'the words of Job are ended' - integrity staked publicly, demanding a hearing

units.characteristics: the young man's zeal; understanding not from age but from the spirit
units.gist: Elihu enters, burning with anger; 'it is the spirit in man, the breath of the Almighty, that makes him understand. It is not the old who are wise' - understanding as a breath-given faculty, not seniority

units.characteristics: the pressure of words that must be spoken
units.gist: 'I am full of words; the spirit within me constrains me. My belly is like wine that has no vent... I must speak, that I may find relief' - the interior pressure of conviction demanding utterance

units.characteristics: the sincere heart's speech; a fellow-creature, not a terror
units.gist: Elihu to Job - 'my words declare the uprightness of my heart'; 'I too was pinched off from a piece of clay; no fear of me need terrify you' - a mediating voice offering to speak without crushing

units.characteristics: God speaking to turn man from pride; suffering as warning
units.gist: 'God speaks in one way, and in two, though man does not perceive it' - in dreams and terrors 'he opens the ears of men... that he may turn man aside from his deed and conceal pride from a man' - suffering as God's speech to the interior

units.characteristics: the mediator and the ransom; restoration of the soul
units.gist: GEM - the sufferer on his bed, soul drawing near the pit; 'if there be for him an angel, a mediator... I have found a ransom'; then 'he sees his face with a shout of joy' - the mediator-longing answered in Elihu's vision (thread w/ 9:33, 16:19, 19:25)

units.characteristics: God's repeated rescue of the soul from the pit
units.gist: 'God does all these things, twice, three times, with a man, to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be lighted with the light of life' - the patient, repeated divine effort to reclaim a person

units.characteristics: the vindication of God's justice; the breath that sustains all
units.gist: Elihu - 'far be it from God that he should do wickedness'; 'if he should gather to himself his spirit and his breath, all flesh would perish together' - all life held moment by moment in God's breath

units.characteristics: the all-seeing eye; no darkness hides the self
units.gist: 'his eyes are on the ways of a man, and he sees all his steps. There is no gloom or deep darkness where evildoers may hide' - the interior and its deeds fully exposed to God (cf. Ecc 12:14)

units.characteristics: God above human merit; sin and righteousness touch only man
units.gist: 'if you are righteous, what do you give to him?... your wickedness concerns a man like yourself, and your righteousness a son of man' - God not enriched or harmed by human conduct; merit relativised

units.characteristics: the empty cry; God who gives songs in the night
units.gist: GEM - why cries go unanswered: 'none says, Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night'; the cry of mere pain, not of seeking, God 'does not regard' - and the beautiful phrase 'songs in the night' (joy God gives in darkness)

units.characteristics: affliction that opens the ear; discipline toward return
units.gist: GEM - 'he opens their ears to instruction and commands that they return from iniquity'; 'he delivers the afflicted BY their affliction and opens their ear BY adversity' - suffering as the instrument that unstops the deaf interior

units.characteristics: the warning not to turn to iniquity under pressure
units.gist: 'beware lest wrath entice you into scoffing'; 'do not long for the night'; 'take care; do not turn to iniquity, for this you have chosen rather than affliction' - the danger that suffering tempts the sufferer to sin

units.characteristics: awe rising before the storm; God great beyond knowing
units.gist: 'God is great, and we know him not; the number of his years is unsearchable'; the gathering storm as God's approach - the shift from argument to AWE (prelude to the theophany)

units.characteristics: the heart trembling at the thunder of God's voice
units.gist: 'at this also my heart trembles and leaps out of its place'; the thunder, lightning, snow, ice all at God's word - the interior shaken by the sheer voice of God in the storm

units.characteristics: stop and consider; the God we cannot find, whom men fear
units.gist: 'stop and consider the wondrous works of God'; 'the Almighty - we cannot find him; he is great in power... therefore men fear him; he does not regard any who are wise in their own conceit' - awe as the fitting posture, humbling self-conceit

units.characteristics: God's questioning that resizes the self; where were you?
units.gist: GEM - the LORD from the whirlwind: 'who is this that darkens counsel by words without knowledge?'; 'where were you when I laid the foundation of the earth... when the morning stars sang together?' - the self dwarfed and re-placed by God's questions

units.characteristics: the wonders of sky and storm; wisdom in the inward parts
units.gist: snow, hail, rain, lightning, the constellations; 'who has put wisdom in the inward parts or given understanding to the mind?' - even the interior faculty of understanding is God's gift, not man's achievement

units.characteristics: God's provision for the wild; care beyond man's control
units.gist: 'can you hunt the prey for the lion... who provides for the raven its prey, when its young cry to God?' - God feeding what man neither tames nor sees; providence beyond the human frame

units.characteristics: the untameable wild; freedom man did not give
units.gist: the mountain goats, the wild donkey 'let go free', the wild ox that will not serve - a creation of untamed freedom that answers to God, not to man; the human bid to control relativised

units.characteristics: the ostrich, horse and hawk; strange wisdom and fearless might
units.gist: the ostrich 'God has made forget wisdom'; the horse who 'laughs at fear... swallows the ground'; the hawk and eagle - creatures whose instincts (fearlessness, folly, sight) God alone authored

units.characteristics: the hand on the mouth; first submission
units.gist: GEM - 'shall a faultfinder contend with the Almighty?'; Job's first yielding: 'behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth' - the arguing self falls silent

units.characteristics: Behemoth; the creature man cannot master
units.gist: 'behold, Behemoth, which I made as I made you'; his strength in his loins, confident though the river rages - a power man did not make and cannot subdue

units.characteristics: Leviathan; the mirror of untameable pride
units.gist: GEM - Leviathan, whom none dares stir up; 'the hope of a man is false; he is laid low even at the sight of him'; 'he is king over all the sons of pride' - the creature that exposes the limits of human power and pride

units.characteristics: from hearsay to sight; repentance in dust and ashes
units.gist: GEM - the climax of the whole book: 'I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you; therefore I despise myself, and repent in dust and ashes' - the shift from knowing-about-God to SEEING him, transforming the self

units.characteristics: the honest sufferer vindicated; intercession for the friends
units.gist: GEM - God to Eliphaz: 'you have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has'; and Job must PRAY for his friends - the one who argued honestly is vindicated over the pious defenders, and made their intercessor

units.characteristics: restoration in the act of praying for others
units.gist: 'the LORD restored the fortunes of Job WHEN HE HAD PRAYED FOR HIS FRIENDS'; double blessing, new children, dies 'old and full of days' - the turn outward (intercession) as the hinge of restoration
